ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal regions are dominated by contiguous low-intensity dark pigmentation. High-intensity white pigmentation is localized to the distal lobes. Dark, vertical linear bands (rake marks) create a high-contrast striped pattern over the white distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 18 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of ~0.15 relative to fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3-10 pixels forming a jagged, irregular profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a moderate concave curve from the median notch, transitioning into a sharp convex sweep at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) detected on the extreme outer margin of the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of vertical and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the light-pigmented distal surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular indentation (tissue loss) on the far-left trailing edge; deep, thick vertical rake marks present on the lower-left ventral quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent 'J' shaped dark pigmentation mark located in the mid-ventral region of the left lobe.
